decisions.reason: This air fin cooler remains close to the firm's core thermal-engineering knowledge, so continued learning from customers, testing and in-house R&D makes retention more likely than withdrawal.

Although condenser offerings can be rationalized, this surviving model fits the established portfolio and the firm has the absorptive capacity to refine and position it better after dropping Product C.
The tube liner builds on the firm's service installed base and corrosion know-how, giving it strong scope for commercial learning and low likelihood of exit.
This customized air cooler line strongly matches the firm's solution-oriented business model, engineering capabilities and broad customer base, so it is very likely to stay.
These repair inserts complement lifecycle services and use existing maintenance knowledge, which supports incremental improvement and makes dropping them relatively unlikely.
